In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/console-operator/pull/1186):

>## Revert of #1178
>
>This reverts merge commit e1b40700219588a89d911bfcc9ac85814965576e (PR #1178: _skip generation check when deployment was just updated_).
>
>### Why
>
>PR #1178 modified `sync_v400.go` to skip `checkDeploymentGenerationProgress()` when `depChanged=true`. This suppresses the console operator from reporting `Progressing=True` during upgrades, breaking the CVO invariant test `clusteroperator/console must go Progressing=True during an upgrade test`.
>
>This caused **5 consecutive 5.0 CI payload rejections** (~93.8h without an accepted payload):
>- **aggregated-aws-ovn-upgrade-5.0-major** — failed 6/10 runs (historical pass rate: 100%)
>- **aggregated-azure-ovn-upgrade-5.0-major** — failed 5/9 runs (historical pass rate: 100%)
>
>### Tracking
>
>- Jira: [TRT-2780](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/TRT-2780)
>- [AI payload analysis report](https://gcsweb-ci.apps.ci.l2s4.p1.openshiftapps.com/gcs/test-platform-results/logs/periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-claude-payload-agent/2075384316900151296/artifacts/claude-payload-agent/openshift-claude-payload-agent/artifacts/payload-analysis-5.0.0-0.ci-2026-07-10-004133-summary.html)
>
>### Files changed
>
>- `pkg/console/operator/sync_v400.go` — restores `checkDeploymentGenerationProgress()` call path
>- `pkg/console/operator/sync_v400_test.go` — removes test added in #1178
>
>/cc @sg00dwin
